name: Path of the Storm Herald
description: A legacy barbarian subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Desert
grants.description: When the Desert aura activates, every other creature in it takes Fire damage: 2 at Barbarian level 3, 3 at level 5, 4 at level 10, 5 at level 15, and 6 at level 20.

grants.name: Sea
grants.description: When the Sea aura activates, choose one other creature in it. A failed Dexterity save deals 1d6 Lightning damage, or half on a success. Damage becomes 2d6 at Barbarian level 10, 3d6 at 15, and 4d6 at 20.

grants.name: Tundra
grants.description: When the Tundra aura activates, chosen creatures in it gain Temporary Hit Points: 2 at Barbarian level 3, 3 at level 5, 4 at level 10, 5 at level 15, and 6 at level 20.

grants.name: Storm Aura
grants.description: Choose Desert, Sea, or Tundra when you gain this feature, changing it whenever you gain a Barbarian level. While raging, the 10-foot aura activates when Rage begins and again when you use a Bonus Action. Its save DC is 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Constitution modifier.

grants.name: Desert
grants.description: Gain Fire resistance and ignore extreme heat. As an action, ignite an unattended flammable object you touch.

grants.name: Sea
grants.description: Gain Lightning resistance, the ability to breathe underwater, and a 30-foot Swim Speed.

grants.name: Tundra
grants.description: Gain Cold resistance and ignore extreme cold. As an action, freeze a creature-free 5-foot cube of water you touch for 1 minute.

grants.name: Storm Soul
grants.description: Your chosen Storm Aura environment grants its Desert, Sea, or Tundra benefit even while the aura is inactive.

grants.name: Shielding Storm
grants.description: Chosen creatures inside your Storm Aura share the damage resistance granted by your Storm Soul.

grants.name: Desert
grants.description: Immediately after a creature in your aura hits you, use your reaction to force a Dexterity save; on a failure it takes Fire damage equal to half your Barbarian level.

grants.name: Sea
grants.description: When you hit a creature in your aura, use your reaction to force a Strength save; on a failure it falls Prone.

grants.name: Tundra
grants.description: Whenever your Storm Aura activates, choose one creature you can see in it. On a failed Strength save, its Speed becomes 0 until your next turn begins.

grants.name: Raging Storm
grants.description: Your chosen environment upgrades Storm Aura: Desert retaliates against attackers, Sea can knock a struck target Prone, and Tundra can reduce one target's Speed to 0.
